content: Tauri is frontend-framework-agnostic; React remains the most-used framework in the Tauri ecosystem (largest library ecosystem, most starter templates, most hiring/community support), while Svelte/SvelteKit offers smaller bundle size and no virtual-DOM overhead, attractive for lightweight desktop-bound apps. For a single-developer project prioritizing ecosystem maturity, component libraries, and long-term maintainability, React is the safer default; Svelte is a valid alternative if minimizing footprint is a higher priority than ecosystem breadth.
